decisions.question: Effort for each model of the split?

options.label: Fixed: Sonnet high, Opus asked
options.summary: Code agents always high (per-model entry + the Agent call's effort), plus top-level effortLevel high for cloud agents. The setup asks only the Opus main-session effort. DS5 is reworked to this and folded into DS6.

options.label: Fixed: everything high
options.summary: No question at all. Top-level effortLevel high and both per-model entries high. DS5's question is dropped.

options.label: Keep asking, high preselected
options.summary: DS5 ships as built, but high is offered as the default answer for code agents, and top-level effortLevel high is added for cloud agents.

decisions.question: Where do the role rules live?

options.label: Plugin-owned rule file
options.summary: Install the block as .claude/rules/agents-and-integration.md, replaced on every run like model-delegation.md. Reaches every project, including ones with a hand-written CLAUDE.md. The CLAUDE.md template drops those sections.

options.label: CLAUDE.md template only
options.summary: Put the block in the CLAUDE.md template. Only projects without a CLAUDE.md get it.

options.label: Explore on Sonnet, Plan on Opus
options.summary: The plugin ships an agent named Explore pinned to Sonnet (search is mechanical); Plan stays on Opus (it is design work).

options.label: Explore on Haiku, Plan on Opus
options.summary: Cheapest search; Haiku may miss subtle matches in large repos.

options.label: Leave both on Opus
options.summary: No override; highest quality, highest cost.

options.label: By kind of work
options.summary: Judgment skills (spec-new, the three audits, tech-stack-setup, auth-setup) on Opus at high; mechanical skills (spec-check, project-artifact-check, task-add, task-status-update) on Sonnet at medium; claude-setup on Sonnet at high.

options.label: All inherit the session
options.summary: No per-skill model or effort; every skill runs on whatever the main session uses.

decisions.question: Saved effort when an alias moves?

options.label: Warn at session start
options.summary: A session-start hook checks that the current Opus and Sonnet IDs have an effort entry and tells you to re-run claude-setup if not. Aliases keep following new models.

options.label: Pin full model IDs
options.summary: Settings name exact IDs (claude-opus-5-5) everywhere, so nothing drifts; new models are adopted only when claude-setup is re-run.

options.label: Ship Explore.md on Haiku
options.summary: claude-setup writes a user or project agent named Explore with model: haiku and effort medium. Test 1: same answers on 10 of 10 lookups for about a seventeenth of the cost. Needs R5 changed.

options.label: Keep Explore on Sonnet
options.summary: No change. Explore keeps following CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (Sonnet). Simplest, costs about 17 times more per lookup.

options.label: Ask in claude-setup
options.summary: claude-setup asks Haiku or Sonnet for Explore, Haiku preselected.

options.label: Opus after one failed try
options.summary: A Sonnet agent that fails its test or reports NOT READY once is relaunched on Opus (medium; high if it fails again), not on Sonnet xhigh. Test 2: Opus passed a fix Sonnet high missed.

options.label: Sonnet xhigh first, then Opus
options.summary: Raise Sonnet to xhigh once, then go to Opus. Cheaper per token, but Sonnet xhigh costs more per task than Opus high on the general index.

options.label: No written rule
options.summary: The orchestrator decides each time.

decisions.question: Model and effort for bug-fix agents?

options.label: Sonnet high, Opus on failure
options.summary: Test 2: Sonnet high passed 3 of 5 at $0.31 per pass; escalating its 2 failures to Opus gives 4 of 5 for about the cost of Opus alone. A loose spec or git logic goes straight to Opus medium.

options.label: Opus medium for every fix
options.summary: Test 2: 4 of 5 passed, $0.42 per pass, about 1.8 times Sonnet per run. Fewer reruns and fewer gaps to fill in the brief.

options.label: Sonnet medium, as today
options.summary: No change: every code agent at medium. Not tested here.

options.label: Table in agents-and-integration.md
options.summary: claude-setup writes the routing table of section 7 into the rule file, so every Agent call sets model and effort by kind of work.

options.label: Split the effort question only
options.summary: Keep the rule file; claude-setup asks review effort and implementation effort apart.

options.label: No change
options.summary: The rule file keeps one line per role.

decisions.question: Offer opusplan for the main session?

options.label: Offer, off by default
options.summary: claude-setup mentions opusplan as an option for multi-file planning and warns that each switch re-reads the context.

options.label: Make it the default
options.summary: The main session runs opusplan: Opus to plan, Sonnet to build.

options.label: Do not offer
options.summary: Keep Sonnet with Opus by /model.
